description: Audit Python dependencies for known CVEs using the OSV database. Reads exact versions from uv.lock, poetry.lock or Pipfile.lock, falling back to requirements.txt / pyproject.toml

directory.description: Path to the directory containing requirements.txt or pyproject.toml

exploitData.description: Add CISA KEV (exploited in the wild) and FIRST EPSS data and order findings by it (default: true; sends CVE IDs only)

includeDevDeps.description: Include dev groups from poetry.lock, uv.lock or Pipfile.lock (default: false)

name: audit_pip
